fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA, BRKB) rose 11% this year but received a 2-star rating from Morningstar relative to a fair value of $510 per B share, resulting in a moderate overvaluation assessment.
fields.summary_ko.1: Competitive advantage assessment is positive for BNSF Railway and other rail and transportation, manufacturing and services segments, but insurance and utilities are evaluated as having limited competitive strength, with $364.7B in liquid assets as of June 2026.
